#!redact-secret-corpus v1
#
# The scan corpus for redact-secret.py --self-test. This file is DECLARED test
# data by the magic line above, so the scanner reports it as SKIPPED rather than
# scanning it -- visibly, in its output, and only until you pass
# --no-corpus-skip. It is never silently excluded.
#
# Two rules for editing it:
#
#   1. MUST-MATCH holds SYNTHETIC values only. Never paste a live credential
#      here: this is the one section a real key could hide in, because it is
#      supposed to look like keys.
#   2. MUST-NOT-MATCH is self-policing. Anything credible you put here FAILS the
#      self-test as a false positive, so a real key cannot hide in this section.
#
# One sample per line. Blank lines and lines whose first non-space character is
# '#' are ignored. Leading whitespace inside a sample is preserved.
#
# Key SHAPES are written as TEMPLATES, never as literal key-shaped runs, and the
# loader expands them deterministically before scanning:
#
#     {A:n}  n chars of mixed-case alphanumeric   {D:n}  n digits
#     {U:n}  n uppercase alphanumeric             {H:n}  n lowercase hex
#     {L:n}  n lowercase letters
#
# This is not cosmetic. GitHub push protection REJECTED this file when the shapes
# were literal -- it read the synthetic sk_live_ and xoxb- fixtures as a live
# Stripe and Slack key. Templates also mean this file cannot physically hold a
# leaked credential, and tests/test_redact_secret.sh enforces that by scanning it
# with --no-corpus-skip and requiring zero token hits.

# ============================== MUST-MATCH ==============================
# Every documented credential shape. A miss here is a FALSE NEGATIVE -- a real
# key the sweep would have walked straight past.
sk-ant-api03-{A:95}
sk-ant-sid01-{A:95}
sk-proj-{A:48}
sk-svcacct-{A:30}
sk-{A:48}
sk-{L:40}
sk_live_{A:24}
sk_test_{A:24}
sk-or-v1-{H:64}
ghp_{A:36}
gho_{A:36}
github_pat_11{A:22}_{A:59}
ghs_{A:36}
AKIA{U:16}
ASIA{U:16}
AIza{A:35}
glpat-{A:20}
hf_{A:34}
xoxb-{D:13}-{D:13}-{A:24}
password="{A:16}"
DB_PASSWORD=hunter2Hunter2!
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.{A:24}
api_key: {A:26}
# ============================ MUST-NOT-MATCH ============================
# Seeded with the ACTUAL hits improvised greps produced across several sessions.
# A hit here is a FALSE POSITIVE -- noise that trains us to stop believing the
# scan, which is how a real key gets missed.
